mapper.select: SELECT /* RequestForm.retrieveMenuData */ lmm.menu_id , lmm.menu_name , lmm.system_code AS menu_system_code , lmm.module_code AS menu_module_code , lmm.high_menu_id , lmm.program_id , lpm.program_name , lpm.system_code AS program_system_code , lpm.module_code AS program_module_code FROM lgcom_menu_m lmm , lgcom_program_m lpm WHERE lmm.menu_id = #{menuId} AND lmm.program_id = lpm.program_id(+)

SELECT /* RequestForm.retrieveRequestFormInfomationTab */ article_write_content AS manual_content , etc_attach_file_id AS attach_file_id FROM LGCOM_PROGRAM_USE_HELP_N a WHERE program_id = #{programId} AND language_code = DECODE((SELECT COUNT(1) FROM LGCOM_PROGRAM_USE_HELP_N WHERE program_id = a.program_id AND language_code = #{USER_SESSION.languageCode}),1,#{USER_SESSION.languageCode},(SELECT language_code FROM LGCOM_PROGRAM_USE_HELP_N WHERE program_id = a.program_id AND ROWNUM = 1))

SELECT /* RequestForm.retrieveAttachmentList */ file_id , file_group_id , system_code , module_code , file_name , file_desc , file_size , file_location_info , #{downloadURL} || '/common/' || file_id AS download_url FROM lgcom_attach_file_info WHERE file_group_id = #{attachFileId} ORDER BY file_id

SELECT /* RequestForm.retrieveRequestHeadInfo */ arn.request_master_id , arn.request_code , arn.organization_id , arn.request_no , arn.request_title , arn.comment_content AS request_comment , arn.submission_objective_content AS request_remark , arn.status_code , (SELECT common_code_name FROM LGCOM_COMMON_CODE_MULTI_LANG_C WHERE code_type_code = 'LGCOM_APPROVAL_REQ_STATUS_CODE' AND language_code = NVL(#{USER_SESSION.languageCode},'en') AND common_code = arn.status_code) AS status_name , TO_CHAR(request_date,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS request_date , arn.requestor_id , umv.user_name AS requestor_emp_no , umv.full_name_local || '/' || NVL(umv.position_name,umv.title_name) || '/' || umv.organization_name_eng AS requestor_info , arn.department_code , umv.organization_name_eng AS department_name FROM LGCOM_APPROVAL_REQUEST_N arn , LGCOM_USER_M_V umv WHERE arn.request_master_id = #{requestMasterId} AND arn.request_code = #{requestCode} AND arn.requestor_id = umv.application_user_id(+)

SELECT /* RequestForm.retrieveRequestEmptyHeadInfo */ '' AS request_master_id , '' AS request_code , '' AS organization_id , '' AS request_no , '' AS request_title , '' AS request_comment , '' AS request_remark , '10' AS status_code , (SELECT common_code_name FROM LGCOM_COMMON_CODE_MULTI_LANG_C WHERE code_type_code = 'LGCOM_APPROVAL_REQ_STATUS_CODE' AND language_code = NVL(#{USER_SESSION.languageCode},'en') AND common_code = '10') AS status_name , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS request_date , application_user_id AS requestor_id , user_name AS requestor_emp_no , full_name_local || '/' || nvl(position_name,title_name) || '/' || organization_name_eng AS requestor_info , department_code , organization_name_eng AS department_name FROM LGCOM_USER_M_V WHERE application_user_id = #{USER_SESSION.applicationUserId}

SELECT /* RequestForm.retrievePortalMandatorInfo */ p_approval_seqs AS approval_seqs , p_process_seq_no AS process_seq_no , p_approval_action_code AS approval_action_code , p_approval_action_name AS approval_action_name , p_user_dept_code AS department_code , p_user_dept_name AS department_name , NVL(p_user_position_name,p_user_title_name) AS position_name , p_user_title_name AS title_name , p_user_id AS application_user_id , p_user_no AS employee_no , p_user_name AS employee_name , CASE WHEN TRIM(p_user_name) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE p_user_name || ' / ' || NVL(p_user_position_name,p_user_title_name) || ' / ' || p_user_dept_name END AS approver_info , p_approval_status_code AS approval_status_code , p_approval_status_name AS approval_status_name , TO_CHAR(p_approval_date,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS approval_date , p_approval_comment AS approval_comment , p_mand_emp_user_id AS mandator_user_id , p_mandator_employee_no AS mandator_employee_no , p_mand_emp_name AS mandator_employee_name , p_mand_emp_dept_code AS mandator_department_code , p_mand_emp_dept_name AS mandator_department_name , NVL(p_mand_position_name,p_mand_emp_title_name) AS mandator_position_name , p_mand_emp_title_name AS mandator_title_name , CASE WHEN TRIM(p_mand_emp_name) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE p_mand_emp_name || ' / ' || NVL(p_mand_position_name,p_mand_emp_title_name) || ' / ' || p_mand_emp_dept_name END AS mandator_info , NVL(p_settlement_delete_flag,'Y') AS settlement_delete_flag , p_approval_line_id AS approval_line_id FROM TABLE(LGCOM_BIZWEB_APPROVAL_PKG.GET_PORTAL_MANDATOR_INFO(#{applicationUserId}))

SELECT /* RequestForm.retrieveApprovalLineList */ ap.request_master_id , ap.request_code , ap.approval_seqs , ((ap.process_seq_no / 10) - 1) AS process_seq_no , ap.approval_action_code , cd.common_code_name AS approval_action_name , umv.department_code , umv.organization_name_eng AS department_name , NVL(umv.position_name,umv.title_name) AS position_name , umv.title_name , umv.application_user_id , ap.user_no AS employee_no , umv.full_name_local AS employee_name , CASE WHEN TRIM(umv.full_name_local) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE umv.full_name_local || ' / ' || NVL(umv.position_name,umv.title_name) || ' / ' || umv.organization_name_eng END AS approver_info , ap.approval_status_code , cd1.common_code_name AS approval_status_name , TO_CHAR(ap.approval_date,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS approval_date , ap.approval_comment , mum.application_user_id AS mandator_user_id , ap.mandator_employee_no , mum.full_name_local AS mandator_employee_name , mum.department_code AS mandator_department_code , mum.organization_name_eng AS mandator_department_name , NVL(mum.position_name, mum.title_name) AS mandator_position_name , mum.title_name AS mandator_title_name , CASE WHEN TRIM(mum.full_name_local) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE mum.full_name_local || ' / ' || NVL(mum.position_name,mum.title_name) || ' / ' || mum.organization_name_eng END AS mandator_info , NVL(ap.settlement_delete_flag,'Y') AS settlement_delete_flag , ap.approval_line_id , umv.susp_resignation_flag AS approver_resignation_flag FROM LGCOM_APPROVAL_STATUS_N ap , LGCOM_USER_M_V umv , LGCOM_USER_M_V mum , ( SELECT /* Approval Action Code */ lcc.common_code , lccm.common_code_name FROM LGCOM_CODE_TYPE_CODE_C lct , LGCOM_COMMON_CODE_C lcc , LGCOM_COMMON_CODE_MULTI_LANG_C lccm WHERE lct.code_type_code = lcc.code_type_code AND lct.code_type_code = lccm.code_type_code AND lcc.common_code = lccm.common_code AND lcc.company_id = lccm.company_id AND lcc.inventory_organization_id = lccm.inventory_organization_id AND lcc.code_type_code = lccm.code_type_code AND lcc.use_flag = 'Y' AND lccm.language_code = #{USER_SESSION.languageCode} AND lcc.code_type_code = 'LGCOM_APPROVAL_ACTION_CODE' AND NVL(lcc.apply_start_date, SYSDATE) <= SYSDATE AND NVL(lcc.apply_end_date, SYSDATE) >= SYSDATE ) cd , -- ( SELECT /* 결재상태코드 */ lcc.common_code , lccm.common_code_name FROM LGCOM_CODE_TYPE_CODE_C lct , LGCOM_COMMON_CODE_C lcc , LGCOM_COMMON_CODE_MULTI_LANG_C lccm WHERE lct.code_type_code = lcc.code_type_code AND lct.code_type_code = lccm.code_type_code AND lcc.common_code = lccm.common_code AND lcc.company_id = lccm.company_id AND lcc.inventory_organization_id = lccm.inventory_organization_id AND lcc.code_type_code = lccm.code_type_code AND lcc.use_flag = 'Y' AND lccm.language_code = #{USER_SESSION.languageCode} AND lcc.code_type_code = 'LGCOM_APPROVAL_STATUS_CODE' AND NVL(lcc.apply_start_date, SYSDATE) <= SYSDATE AND NVL(lcc.apply_end_date, SYSDATE) >= SYSDATE ) cd1 WHERE ap.user_no = umv.user_name(+) AND ap.mandator_employee_no = mum.user_name(+) AND ap.approval_action_code = cd.common_code(+) AND ap.approval_status_code = cd1.common_code(+) AND ap.request_master_id = #{requestMasterId} AND ap.request_code = #{requestCode} AND ap.approval_seqs BETWEEN 1 AND 9999 ORDER BY ap.approval_seqs

SELECT /* RequestForm.retrieveCarbonCopyList */ asn.request_master_id , asn.request_code , asn.approval_action_code , asn.approval_seqs , umv.application_user_id , asn.user_no AS employee_no , umv.full_name_local AS employee_name , umv.position_name AS position_name , umv.title_name , umv.organization_name_eng AS department_name , TO_CHAR(asn.approval_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS approval_date FROM LGCOM_APPROVAL_STATUS_N asn , LGCOM_USER_M_V umv WHERE asn.request_master_id = #{requestMasterId} AND asn.request_code = #{requestCode} AND asn.approval_action_code = 'REFERENCE' AND asn.user_no = umv.user_name(+) ORDER BY asn.approval_seqs

SELECT /* RequestForm.retrieveForwarderList */ z2.common_code_name AS approval_action_name , lasn.approval_seqs , lasn.user_no , lasn.approval_action_code AS type , lumv.department_code AS refer_dept_code , lumv.full_name_local || '/' || nvl(lumv.position_name, lumv.title_name) || '/' ||lumv.organization_name_eng AS refer_emp_name , TO_CHAR( lasn.approval_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI' ) AS approval_date FROM LGCOM_APPROVAL_STATUS_N lasn , LGCOM_USER_M_V lumv , LGCOM_COMMON_CODE_C z1 , LGCOM_COMMON_CODE_MULTI_LANG_C z2 WHERE lasn.approval_action_code = 'FORWARD' AND lasn.user_no = lumv.user_name AND lasn.approval_action_code = z1.common_code AND Z1.code_type_code = 'LGCOM_APPROVAL_ACTION_CODE' AND Z1.code_type_code = Z2.CODE_TYPE_CODE AND Z1.common_code = Z2.common_code AND Z2.language_code = #{USER_SESSION.languageCode} AND lasn.request_master_id = #{requestMasterId} AND lasn.request_code = #{requestCode} ORDER BY lasn.approval_seqs

SELECT /* RequestForm.retrieveReviewerList */ approval_seqs , approval_action_name , type , open_flag , request_emp_name , request_comment , request_date , review_emp_name , review_comment , review_date , attachment_req_number FROM ( SELECT x.approval_seqs AS approval_seqs , z2.common_code_name AS approval_action_name , x.approval_action_code AS type , x.share_flag AS open_flag , r2.full_name_local || '/' || nvl(r2.position_name,r2.title_name) || '/' || r2.organization_name_eng AS request_emp_name , x.inspection_comment AS request_comment , TO_CHAR(x.creation_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS request_date , r1.full_name_local || '/' || nvl(r1.position_name,r1.title_name) || '/' || r1.organization_name_eng AS review_emp_name , x.approval_comment AS review_comment , TO_CHAR(x.approval_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS review_date , x.approval_line_id as attachment_req_number FROM LGCOM_APPROVAL_STATUS_N x , LGCOM_COMMON_CODE_C z1 , LGCOM_COMMON_CODE_MULTI_LANG_C z2 , LGCOM_USER_M_V r1 , LGCOM_USER_M_V r2 WHERE x.request_master_id = #{requestMasterId} AND x.request_code = #{requestCode} AND x.approval_seqs >= '30000' AND x.approval_action_code = 'PREVIEW' AND x.approval_action_code = z1.common_code AND z1.code_type_code = 'LGCOM_APPROVAL_ACTION_CODE' AND z1.code_type_code = 'LGCOM_APPROVAL_ACTION_CODE' AND z1.code_type_code = z2.code_type_code AND z1.common_code = z2.common_code AND z2.language_code = #{USER_SESSION.languageCode} AND x.user_no = r1.user_name AND x.mandator_employee_no = r2.user_name UNION SELECT x.approval_seqs AS approval_seqs , z2.common_code_name AS approval_action_name , x.approval_action_code AS type , x.share_flag AS open_flag , r2.full_name_local || '/' || nvl(r2.position_name,r2.title_name) || '/' || r2.organization_name_eng AS request_emp_name , x.inspection_comment AS request_comment , TO_CHAR(x.creation_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS request_date , r1.full_name_local || '/' || nvl(r1.position_name,r1.title_name) || '/' || r1.organization_name_eng AS review_emp_name , x.approval_comment AS review_comment , TO_CHAR(x.approval_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS approval_date , x.approval_line_id AS attachment_req_number FROM LGCOM_APPROVAL_STATUS_N x , LGCOM_COMMON_CODE_C z1 , LGCOM_COMMON_CODE_MULTI_LANG_C z2 , LGCOM_USER_M_V r1 , LGCOM_USER_M_V r2 WHERE x.request_master_id = #{requestMasterId} AND x.request_code = #{requestCode} AND x.approval_seqs >= '30000' AND x.approval_action_code = 'PREVIEW' AND x.approval_action_code = z1.common_code AND z1.code_type_code = 'LGCOM_APPROVAL_ACTION_CODE' AND z1.code_type_code = 'LGCOM_APPROVAL_ACTION_CODE' AND z1.code_type_code = z2.code_type_code AND z1.common_code = z2.common_code AND z2.language_code = 'en' AND x.user_no = r1.user_name AND x.mandator_employee_no = r2.user_name AND x.share_flag = 'Y' AND EXISTS (SELECT 'Y' FROM LGCOM_APPROVAL_STATUS_N WHERE request_master_id = x.request_master_id AND request_code = x.request_code AND approval_action_code = x.approval_action_code AND (user_no = #{USER_SESSION.userName} OR mandator_employee_no = #{USER_SESSION.userName})) ) ORDER BY approval_seqs

SELECT /* RequestForm.retrieveDuplicateForwarder */ request_master_id , request_code , approval_seqs , organization_id , process_seq_no , progress_code , user_no FROM LGCOM_APPROVAL_STATUS_N WHERE request_master_id = #{requestMasterId} AND request_code = #{requestCode} AND user_no = #{forwarderEmpNo} AND approval_action_code = 'FORWARD'
